content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto is about more than just making a transaction; it's about establishing a direct and sustainable revenue stream without relying on third-party platforms that impose high fees. When you use traditional platforms like Gumroad, you can lose up to 10% of your revenue on every sale. By contrast, using NOWPayments only charges a 0.5% fee, meaning that for the same number of sales, you can keep significantly more of your income. This shift in infrastructure allows digital creators to maintain ownership and control over their commerce without being subject to the whims of external payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling your Notion templates is built on free and accessible tools that work in tandem to create a seamless experience. You start with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allows you to display your products online at no cost. The backend logic can be managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, automating tasks such as order processing and payment verification. Order details are stored securely in platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery can be managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture ensures that you have a fully functional online store without ongoing subscription costs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or impose hefty fees. If you're a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, this stack empowers you to sell digital products directly to your audience while retaining full ownership of your data and revenue. This solution is also perfect for those looking to sell educational content, software, or unique digital assets without the constant concern of payment processing failures or high transaction costs. Ultimately, this system puts you back in control of your business.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign commerce stack include several free tools that come together to create an efficient selling platform. Hosting solutions such as GitHub Pages provide a space for your storefront, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers automate the backend processes. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which allows for the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that you can transact in a manner that best suits your audience. By integrating these tools, you create a robust platform that is not only cost-effective but also resilient against the platform risks associated with traditional transaction systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates for crypto, first choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages to set up your online store. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend operations. After that, set up your payment system with NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency transactions. Store your product information using Supabase or Google Sheets, and finally, configure a file delivery method through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. These steps will empower you to launch your sovereign digital commerce stack quickly and efficiently.

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce stack comprised of free tools for hosting, backend operations, and crypto payment processing. This method ensures you retain more revenue and have full control over your sales compared to traditional platforms that charge significant fees.

It includes all the necessary tools and templates to build your own sovereign commerce stack, enhancing your ability to sell directly to your audience. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
